snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 - Valkyrie on iOS and Android -- Feature Trailer HD
snippet.description:
Valkyrie™, the critically acclaimed add-on to the popular mobile sci-fi action trader Galaxy on Fire 2™, is finally coming to the Android platform, debuting exclusively on Sony Ericsson Xperia™ PLAY. 

The Valkyrie™ add-on offers a thrilling new storyline along with plenty of new spaceships, weapons, and equipment.

All space ship footage captured from in-game graphics and showing original gameplay.
